system.description: You don't need to use this Skill if you're running down a hallway to attack some Mobs. But if you're racing, chasing, or need to get away from a ticking time bomb, this is the Skill you want. Make an Unopposed Skill Check every minute, not every round. Add 1 to your result for every 10ft of Move you have. On Success, you succeed in the run.

upgrades.description: You have a permanent +5ft Move Buff. Make a Check every 2 minutes.
You have an additional permanent +10ft Move Buff. Make a Check every 4 minutes.
You have an additional permanent +15ft Move Buff. Make a Check every 6 minutes.

system.limitations: For short bursts of running. For extended runs, use Endurance instead.
